claims.claim: Correction ingress selects exactly one normalized V1 package by canonical Human/Brain policy and the approved ID/version/digest. Missing, malformed, contradictory or changed policy/profile material fails closed without registry-order selection or V3 fallback.

AUTHOR_REPAIR and AUTHOR_REMEDIATION require exact V1 references in both stages and a validated CANDIDATE. V3-only and mixed handoffs receive explicit profile mismatch errors. Existing lineage, TASK, return-contract, current-main and freshness guards remain intact.
Normalized profile bodies and digests are unchanged. Historical V2/V3 validators remain unchanged, and regression cases preserve exact serialized V3 replay while rejecting profile substitution.

The unchanged V1 procedure retains two stages, eight ordered lenses, final closure, privacy exclusions and TASK conformance guards. Added regressions exercise malicious material, reordered lenses, stale references and extra stages.

Protocol prose and registry annotations identify V1 as the sole prospective profile and distinguish historical V3 status. The migration adds no second production selector, router, persistent reasoning ledger or lifecycle authority.

Deterministic regression cases cover V1 correction authoring, registry permutations, missing/changed selection, V3 and mixed-handoff rejection, historical replay, preserved BO-1 ingress semantics, and bounded invocation counts across all four eligible flows.
The final commit changes only the six permitted files. TASK-341 and RUN-341-001 artifacts were not modified, and no TASK-341 correction or additional AIOS execution was launched.
